title: Pirate simulator
author: Camuslaballe
selftext:
Inspired by Medieval Simulator on Android, I’m making Pirate Simulator with improved graphics and a wider variety of minigames.

I used AI to help write code and build tools to keep the game’s art style consistent. One of those tools is `block-model`. It assembles low-poly 3D models from simple shapes like cubes and spheres, then checks them for errors. I used it to create every 3D model in the game.

I made the trailer with Remotion and generated the music using an AI model running locally.

I just put together a trailer, and pre-registration is now open on Google Play. If it looks like your kind of game, feel free to pre-register!

[Pre-register](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mindsetgames.piratesimulator&referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit)
